name: Comics, Daily
description: Today's comics on one page: The Far Side's daily panels in a row with their captions, then GoComics strips (Garfield, Calvin and Hobbes, Pearls Before Swine, or any other) and an archived Dilbert, full width and in your order. As many rows as fit without cutting one off. Fetched in the background once a day; when a site blocks a download the last good strip stays up and a small note says so.

cell_options.name: far_side
cell_options.label: Far Side
cell_options.help: Today's Far Side panels in a row above the strips.

cell_options.name: far_side_count
cell_options.label: How many
cell_options.help: Far Side panels in the row, 1 to 4. A narrow cell shows fewer.

cell_options.name: captions
cell_options.label: Captions
cell_options.help: The caption under each Far Side panel.

cell_options.name: strips
cell_options.label: Strips
cell_options.help: One per line, top to bottom: a GoComics name as in gocomics.com/<name>, or dilbert for an archived Dilbert. Start a line with # to leave a strip out. To use a picture of your own instead of the download (when a site is blocking it), put its image address after the name on the same line.

presets.label: Garfield, Calvin and Hobbes, Pearls Before Swine, Dilbert

cell_options.name: status_note
cell_options.label: Status note
cell_options.help: A small line at the foot of the page naming any comic that could not be updated today.

cell_options.name: gap
cell_options.label: Gap
cell_options.help: Space between rows in pixels on a 1440 px wide panel; narrower cells scale it down. Spare height widens it up to the largest gap.

cell_options.name: gap_min
cell_options.label: Smallest gap
cell_options.help: How far the gap may shrink to fit one more strip before the last strip is left out.
